assessmentContext.label: Zone 2 automated battery module assembly line

task.changeLabel: Zone 2 material buffer B02 — Increase buffer capacity

selectedConcerns.label: Flow accumulation and buffer state
selectedConcerns.question: Will the change create WIP accumulation or a changed buffer state?
selectedConcerns.whySelected: Required by the fixed concern mapping for buffer-capacity change.

assuranceLimit.supportedClaim: Supports review of changed WIP accumulation and buffer state.
assuranceLimit.excludedClaim: Does not optimise buffer capacity automatically.

requirements.label: Time-ordered buffer occupancy
requirements.rationale: The middleware must know how WIP count changes over time.

requirements.label: Target buffer identity binding
requirements.rationale: The selected Tecnomatix Plant Simulation buffer must resolve to a registered Unity object.

requirements.label: Buffer replay capability
requirements.rationale: The runtime must consume buffer events and present the changed WIP state.

selectedConcerns.label: Operational performance impact
selectedConcerns.question: Does the change affect throughput, waiting, cycle time or machine status?
selectedConcerns.whySelected: Required by the fixed concern mapping for buffer-capacity change.

assuranceLimit.supportedClaim: Supports indicative operational comparison using exported DES events.
assuranceLimit.excludedClaim: Does not provide statistically controlled optimisation proof.

requirements.label: Production and status evidence
requirements.rationale: Operational review needs event throughput and machine-state context.

requirements.label: KPI/status presentation
requirements.rationale: KPI display enriches the task but is not required for spatial feasibility.

selectedConcerns.label: Spatial occupancy and clearance
selectedConcerns.question: How much physical space will WIP or resources occupy after the change?
selectedConcerns.whySelected: Required by the fixed concern mapping for buffer-capacity change.

assuranceLimit.excludedClaim: Does not perform automatic intersection computation, safety validation, standards-conformity assessment or certification.

requirements.label: WIP or movement quantity evidence
requirements.rationale: The runtime needs a time-ordered quantity or event driver for occupied-area presentation.

requirements.label: Product footprint and registered geometry
requirements.rationale: Counts become spatial evidence only after binding to footprint and scene geometry.

requirements.label: Occupied-area overlay
requirements.rationale: The user must inspect the resulting occupied area in the 3D scene.

selectedConcerns.label: Staging-area and aisle interaction
selectedConcerns.question: Will occupied areas interfere with staging or aisle zones?
selectedConcerns.whySelected: Triggered because affected occupancy geometry intersects a registered aisle/staging review context.

activationEvidence.basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

dependencies.basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

assuranceLimit.supportedClaim: Supports visual review of aisle and staging interaction.
assuranceLimit.excludedClaim: Does not decide plant-wide logistics policy.

requirements.label: C3 affected occupancy/swept-area dependency
requirements.rationale: This concern depends on C3-resolved affected occupancy geometry or swept-area evidence.
basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

requirements.label: Aisle or staging zone geometry
requirements.rationale: The runtime needs registered zone polygons to show whether occupied areas affect them.

requirements.label: Zone overlay capability
requirements.rationale: Aisle and staging context must be visible during the engineering task.

selectedConcerns.label: AGV/mobile route interaction
selectedConcerns.question: Will the change obstruct or interfere with the selected mobile-resource route?
selectedConcerns.whySelected: Triggered because affected occupancy/swept-area evidence reaches a registered mobile-resource context.

activationEvidence.basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

dependencies.basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

assuranceLimit.supportedClaim: Supports visual engineering review of potential AGV/mobile route interference.

basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

requirements.label: Time-ordered mobile-resource movement
requirements.rationale: The system must know which mobile resource used which route or route reference.

requirements.label: Registered route geometry and vehicle envelope
requirements.rationale: Route references become assessable only after binding to route geometry and mobile-resource size.

requirements.label: Route replay and overlay
requirements.rationale: The user must inspect mobile-resource movement against occupied areas.

selectedConcerns.label: Workstation and equipment access
selectedConcerns.question: Will the change affect operation, replenishment, inspection or equipment access?
selectedConcerns.whySelected: Triggered because affected occupancy/swept-area evidence reaches a registered access-zone context.

activationEvidence.basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

dependencies.basis: Derived from changed source evidence and registered scene/runtime geometry.

assuranceLimit.supportedClaim: Supports visual review of registered access-zone interaction.
assuranceLimit.excludedClaim: Does not replace ergonomic design validation.

requirements.label: C3 affected occupancy/swept-area dependency
